pullRequests.title: feat: add todo statistics endpoint and progress line
pullRequests.body:
## Requirements - REQ-01: Added `GET /api/todos/stats` endpoint returning `{ total, completed, open }` counts from the current todo list. - REQ-02: Added a `

` progress line showing ` of done`; it updates after every add, toggle, or delete via `fetchTodos()`. ## Testing Ran `npm test` in `app/` — 11 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. ``` ✔ GET /api/todos returns array of tasks ✔ POST /api/todos creates a new valid task ✔ POST /api/todos rejects empty title with 400 ✔ PUT /api/todos/:id updates a todo and preserves its title ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id deletes an existing todo with 204 and empty body ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id returns 404 for non-existent valid ID and leaves todos unchanged ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id rejects invalid IDs with 400 and leaves todos unchanged ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id successfully deletes a todo using a leading-zero ID ✔ GET /api/todos/stats returns total, completed and open counts ✔ GET /api/todos/stats reflects changes after toggle ✔ DELETE /api/todos/:id handles safe-integer boundary correctly tests 11, pass 11, fail 0, skipped 0 ```
